outcomes.outcome: Validate BreezeAI Platform via Automated Sanity and Regression Checks
outcomes.description: Run the automated sanity and regression suites that smoke-test core BreezeAI capabilities across Dev and Prod environments — dashboard availability, project creation, document ingestion with the functional/design/architecture ontologies, metrics generation, theming, project navigation, and design generation.

scenarios.scenario: Launch the BreezeAI dashboard (Dev sanity check)
scenarios.description: Sanity smoke check that the BreezeAI Dev environment loads. Navigates to https://ai.accionbreeze.com/ and asserts the page title matches /Breeze.AI/i. Tagged @sanity; maintained for Chromium only; runs in serial mode.

actions.description: Navigates to https://ai.accionbreeze.com/ waiting for domcontentloaded.
Asserts the document title matches /Breeze.AI/i, confirming the dashboard rendered.

scenarios.scenario: Create a new BreezeAI project (Dev sanity check)
scenarios.description: Creates a project with a timestamped unique name (SanityCheck-<ISO>-Automation) and confirms a project ID is returned; the run fails if no ID comes back.

actions.description: label: Project name; generated as SanityCheck-<timestamp>-Automation to avoid collisions across runs.
Submits the create-project form and asserts a non-empty project ID is returned from the resulting URL or project card.

scenarios.scenario: Upload a document and generate functional metrics (Dev sanity check)
scenarios.description: Opens an existing project, uploads a PDF into the Knowledge Base with the Functional ontology, then triggers functional metrics generation (waits up to ~3 minutes for processing). Marked a critical test.

actions.description: Ensures a project is created and open before uploading a document.

steps.step: Provide a document and request metrics

actions.action: Provide a PDF document for functional ingestion
actions.description: Uploads documents/fileName.pdf via the Knowledge Base with the Functional Ontology selected, then starts analysis.
Triggers functional metrics generation from the Knowledge Base; waits up to ~3 minutes for the metrics to be produced.

scenarios.scenario: Upload a document with the Design ontology (Dev sanity check)
scenarios.description: Opens a project and uploads a PDF into the Knowledge Base selecting the Design Ontology, then starts analysis.

steps.step: Provide a document with the Design ontology

actions.description: Adds documents/fileName.pdf via Add Document and selects Design Ontology before starting analysis.

scenarios.scenario: Upload a document with the Architecture ontology (Dev sanity check)
scenarios.description: Opens a project and uploads a TXT document into the Knowledge Base selecting the Architecture Ontology, then starts analysis.

steps.step: Provide a document with the Architecture ontology

actions.description: Adds documents/fileName.txt via Add Document and selects Architecture Ontology before starting analysis.

scenarios.scenario: Change the application theme (Dev sanity check)
scenarios.description: Opens the user profile options and switches to a different theme, verifying theme selection works.

actions.description: Opens the user profile options to reveal the Themes control.
Reads the currently selected theme and selects a different available theme.

scenarios.scenario: Search and select a project (Dev sanity check)
scenarios.description: Ensures the target project is open by searching for it by name and selecting it, verifying navigation to the project dashboard.

actions.action: Select an existing project by name
actions.description: Searches by project name and opens the matching project; verifies the project dashboard is reached.

scenarios.scenario: Select the first listed project (Dev sanity check)
scenarios.description: Selects the first project card shown on the dashboard to verify project entry works.

actions.description: Opens the first project card displayed on the dashboard.

scenarios.scenario: Open all capability cards on the project dashboard (Dev sanity check)
scenarios.description: Opens each capability card in sequence to verify each feature surface is reachable, returning to project home between each.

actions.description: Sequentially opens the Functional model, Knowledge graph, Architecture modeling, Semantic model, Code ontology, User story, AI chat, and Design cards, returning to project home between each.

scenarios.scenario: Generate design metrics via website creation (Dev sanity check)
scenarios.description: Opens the Design/Mockups card and creates a new website ('Webstie Design') of type Web to exercise design generation.

actions.action: Provide a website name for design generation
actions.description: Opens the Design card, adds a website named 'Webstie Design' with type Web, and confirms creation.

scenarios.scenario: Launch the BreezeAI dashboard (Dev regression check)
scenarios.description: Regression smoke check that the BreezeAI Dev dashboard loads. Navigates to https://ai.accionbreeze.com/ and asserts the title matches /Breeze.AI/i. Tagged @regression.

actions.description: Navigates to https://ai.accionbreeze.com/.
Asserts the document title matches /Breeze.AI/i.

scenarios.scenario: Create a BreezeAI project with a tag (Dev regression check)
scenarios.description: Creates a project with a timestamped name and an accompanying tag, exercising the tag-add flow during creation. Tagged @regression.

steps.step: Provide project details and a tag

actions.description: label: Project name; generated as SanityCheck-<timestamp>-Automation.
label: Tag; a tag (same value as the project name) is added during creation.
Creates the project with name, description, and tag; logs the returned project ID.

scenarios.scenario: Launch the BreezeAI dashboard (Prod sanity check)
scenarios.description: Sanity smoke check for the BreezeAI production dashboard. Navigates to https://ai.accionbreeze.com/ (waiting for domcontentloaded, ~1s settle) and asserts the title matches /Breeze.AI/i. Tagged @sanity.

actions.description: Navigates to https://ai.accionbreeze.com/ and waits ~1s for the page to settle.
Asserts the document title matches /Breeze.AI/i.

outcomes.outcome: Validate AccionConnect Platform via Automated Sanity Checks
outcomes.description: Run the automated sanity suite that smoke-tests AccionConnect availability across the Dev and Prod environments — confirming the content/home pages load and the expected AccionConnect branding is present.

scenarios.scenario: Launch the AccionConnect content page (Dev sanity check)
scenarios.description: Sanity smoke check for the AccionConnect Dev environment. Navigates to https://connect-new.accionbreeze.com/content and asserts the title matches /AccionConnect/i. Tagged @sanity.

actions.description: Navigates to https://connect-new.accionbreeze.com/content.
Asserts the document title matches /AccionConnect/i.

scenarios.scenario: Launch the AccionConnect home page and sign in (Prod sanity check)
scenarios.description: Sanity smoke check for AccionConnect production. Navigates to https://connect.accionlabs.com/home, initiates Accion Labs sign-in if the control is present, and asserts the title matches /AccionConnect|Accion Connect/i. Tagged @sanity.

steps.step: Load the AccionConnect Prod environment and authenticate

actions.description: Navigates to https://connect.accionlabs.com/home.
Selects the Accion Labs sign-in control if present (test id 'Accion-Labs-login-button' or matching text); continues gracefully if not found.
Asserts the document title matches /AccionConnect|Accion Connect/i.
